item.title: Computer Networking & Protocols: Wire-level packet communication, routing logic, and protocol stacks
item.description:
Deconstructing the OSI & TCP/IP models, analyzing packet lifecycles with Wireshark, socket-level communication, and DNS/routing topologies.
Architecture Focus: Layer 3/4 Packet Routing, Sockets & Protocol Analysis Key Topics: Three-Way Handshake & Socket Lifecycle Management • Subnetting, CIDR, NAT, and Routing Tables • Wireshark Deep Packet Inspection & Stream Analysis • DNS Resolution & Recursive Query Architecture Protocols: TCP/IP, UDP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS 1.3, ICMP, OSI Layers
Code Implementation (bash): ss -tulpn | grep -E ':(80|443|3000|5432)' ip route show default ping -c 4 -M do -s 1472 1.1.1.1
item.dc:creator: Yeasin
item.author: yeasin.devx@gmail.com (Yeasin)

item.title: Network Security & Cybersecurity: Threat modeling, access control, encryption, and defensive posture
item.description:
Studying defensive security paradigms, cryptographic standards, packet filtering, firewall configurations, and vulnerability assessments.
Architecture Focus: Zero-Trust Verification, Threat Modeling & Defensive Controls Key Topics: Defensive Network Perimeter & Packet Filtering • Transport Layer Security (TLS) Handshake Decryption • API Security: Prevention of Injection, CSRF, and Broken Auth • Vulnerability Surface Scanning & Hardening Protocols: SSL/TLS, Firewalls / iptables, PKI & Cryptography, OWASP Top 10, Access Control (RBAC)
Code Implementation (bash): curl -sI https://yeasin-sec.vercel.app/api/health | grep -iE '(strict-transport|x-frame|content-security)' openssl s_client -connect yeasin-sec.vercel.app:443 -tls1_3

item.title: Linux Systems & Environment: Kernel primitives, daemon management, shell pipelines, and system internals
item.description:
Harnessing the Linux operating system as a development and server backbone through automation scripting, process inspection, and permission hardening.
Architecture Focus: POSIX Process Lifecycles, Daemons & Automated Pipelines Key Topics: Linux Shell Automation & Pipeline Data Processing • System Services, Daemons & Log Diagnostics (journalctl) • File Permissions (chmod/chown), ACLs, and Sudoers • Process Lifecycle (kill, ps, top, htop, fork/exec) Protocols: Bash / Shell Scripting, systemd, POSIX, SSH Hardening, Process Management, Cron
Code Implementation (bash): sudo systemctl status backend-node.service journalctl -u backend-node.service -f -n 50 ps aux --sort=-%mem | head -n 10
item.dc:creator: Yeasin
item.author: yeasin.devx@gmail.com (Yeasin)

item.title: [LAB-NET-01] Wireshark TCP Handshake & Packet Flow Dissection
item.description:
Capturing and analyzing SYN, SYN-ACK, ACK sequence numbers, window scaling, and connection termination (FIN/RST) across local and remote connections.
Domain: Protocol Analysis | Status: Documented Tools: Wireshark, tcpdump, Raw Sockets, curl Key Takeaway: Deepened practical understanding of transmission reliability, retransmissions, and TCP state machine transitions.
Lab Syntax & Commands (bash): sudo tcpdump -i any -nn -v 'tcp[tcpflags] & (tcp-syn|tcp-ack|tcp-fin) != 0 and port 443' -c 10
item.dc:creator: Yeasin
item.author: yeasin.devx@gmail.com (Yeasin)

item.title: [LAB-SEC-02] REST API Authentication & Header Security Audit
item.description:
Evaluating backend endpoints against missing security headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options), improper CORS policies, and token leakage.
Domain: Defensive Security | Status: Active Lab Tools: Postman, Node.js, JWT Inspector, cURL Key Takeaway: Standardized defensive header practices and token expiration lifecycles on backend microservices.
Lab Syntax & Commands (bash): curl -i -X OPTIONS https://yeasin4745-dev.vercel.app/api/contact \ -H "Origin: https://yeasin-sec.vercel.app" \ -H "Access-Control-Request-Method: POST"
item.dc:creator: Yeasin
item.author: yeasin.devx@gmail.com (Yeasin)

item.title: [LAB-SYS-03] Linux Server Hardening & SSH Key Enforcement
item.description:
Configuring non-root administrative users, enforcing Ed25519 SSH keys, disabling password authentication, and setting up basic UFW firewall rules.
Domain: System Hardening | Status: Active Lab Tools: Ubuntu Server, SSH (Ed25519), UFW / iptables, systemd Key Takeaway: Minimized attack surface on Linux hosts by restricting open ports and eliminating brute-force vectors.
Lab Syntax & Commands (bash): sudo ufw default deny incoming sudo ufw default allow outgoing sudo ufw allow OpenSSH sudo ufw enable && sudo ufw status verbose
item.dc:creator: Yeasin
item.author: yeasin.devx@gmail.com (Yeasin)

item.title: [LAB-NET-04] Subnet Topology & CIDR Allocation Planning
item.description:
Architecting multi-tier network topologies, isolating backend database subnets from public ingress, and calculating broadcast/network address boundaries.
Domain: Networking | Status: Planned Scenario Tools: CIDR Calculators, Network Diagrams, Routing Tables Key Takeaway: Clear principles for network segregation and defense-in-depth layout.
Lab Syntax & Commands (bash): ip -br -c addr show ip route show
